package_info.why_malicious: The provided report is a high-level summary of open source security trends and does not describe any specific malicious package or provide concrete code samples. It highlights the prevalence of vulnerabilities (including Zip Slip, ReDoS, and XSS) but does not attribute these to a particular package or show actual malicious code.

behavioral_signatures: Arbitrary file overwrite via directory traversal in archive extraction (Zip Slip)
Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) via unbounded regex processing
Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in JavaScript packages
file_indicators: Archive extraction routines that do not sanitize file paths
Use of unbounded or complex regular expressions in user input processing
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: To detect these classes of vulnerabilities, scan for archive extraction code that writes files using user-controlled paths (potential Zip Slip), audit regular expressions for patterns that could cause excessive backtracking (ReDoS), and review JavaScript code for unsanitized user input being rendered in the DOM (XSS). Automated static analysis tools and dependency vulnerability scanners can help identify known vulnerable packages.
